It sounds like you're experiencing loading and AI generation issues. Here are some troubleshooting steps:

For the spinning + Add Page button:

  • Clear your browser cache and cookies, then refresh the page
  • Wait a few minutes and retry - temporary server issues might resolve themselves

For AI page generation errors:

  • Ensure you have a stable internet connection and available AI credits
  • Try refreshing the page and attempting again

You can also check if there are any ongoing issues at https://status.gamma.app

If these steps don't resolve the issue, the problem may require further investigation.

source.subject: URGENTE — Erro SSL, redirecionamento indevido e limitação de domínios no Gamma
source.body:
Olá, equipe Gamma.

Preciso de ajuda imediata para resolver três problemas graves que estão comprometendo totalmente o funcionamento das minhas páginas e impactando diretamente as vendas e campanhas em andamento.

🚨 1. Erro SSL — Invalid Certificate (Error 526)

O domínio https://cursomakereal-o85tp03.gamma.site/ está apresentando o erro “Invalid SSL certificate (Error code 526)”, conforme a imagem em anexo.
O Cloudflare indica que o navegador e o proxy estão funcionando normalmente, mas o servidor da Gamma está retornando erro de certificado inválido.
➡️ Isso torna as páginas inacessíveis e está causando perdas diretas de tráfego e conversão.
Solicito que o SSL seja reemitido ou corrigido imediatamente, pois se trata de um problema interno da hospedagem Gamma.

⚠️ 2. Mensagem “You’re Leaving Gamma” em links internos

Mesmo ao usar links que direcionam para outras páginas dentro do próprio Gamma, aparece uma tela intermediária com o aviso em inglês “You’re leaving Gamma”, obrigando o visitante a clicar novamente em “Continue”.
Esse aviso confunde o público, diminui drasticamente as conversões e não faz sentido quando o link é interno.
Peço que essa tela seja desativada para links dentro do domínio .gamma.site ou que seja adicionada uma opção para removê-la manualmente.

🔒 3. Limitação de 10 domínios personalizados

Percebi que a plataforma passou a limitar o uso a apenas 10 domínios personalizados.
Mesmo após excluir domínios antigos que não estão mais em uso, não consigo adicionar novos.
Esse bloqueio está impedindo novas publicações e atualizações de campanhas.
Peço, por favor, que liberem espaço para novos domínios ou aumentem temporariamente o limite da minha conta.

💬 Pedido de contato direto

Esses três problemas estão afetando todo o meu ecossistema de páginas e vendas.
Preciso de atendimento ao vivo (chat, ligação ou videoconferência) o quanto antes, para que possamos resolver em tempo real.

A situação é crítica e peço prioridade máxima neste chamado.

Agradeço pela atenção e aguardo retorno urgente.

Atenciosamente,
Lucas Carvalho

email da conta: lucas.imvdigital@gmail.com

conversation_parts.body:
Cloudflare error 526 typically indicates SSL certificate issues with your custom domains. This is often related to SSL/TLS configuration problems in Cloudflare.

To resolve this issue:

1. Check your Cloudflare SSL/TLS settings:

- Go to SSL/TLS > Overview in your Cloudflare dashboard

- Set the SSL/TLS encryption mode to Full (Strict)

2. Adjust security settings during verification:

- Navigate to Security > Settings

- Set Security Level to Medium during the verification process

Important notes:

- SSL certificates can take a few hours to activate after domain verification

- Security warnings are normal immediately after domain setup and should resolve within a few hours

- If issues persist after 24 hours, this requires examination by our human support team

Since you're experiencing this across multiple sites and it may require certificate reissuance, I'd recommend requesting to speak with a human agent who can examine your specific SSL certificate status and take the necessary actions to resolve this issue.

Ja, Sie können Gamma-Inhalte in Ihre eigene Website einbetten! Allerdings gibt es eine wichtige Einschränkung: Nur Gamma-Dokumente und Präsentationen können eingebettet werden - Gamma-Sites selbst unterstützen das Einbetten nicht.

So betten Sie Gamma-Inhalte ein:

  1. Embed-Code generieren: Öffnen Sie Ihr Gamma-Dokument oder Ihre Präsentation, klicken Sie auf Teilen und wählen Sie Einbetten
  2. Öffentlichen Zugriff aktivieren: Schalten Sie "Öffentlichen Zugriff erlauben" ein und kopieren Sie den generierten iframe-Code
  3. Code zur Website hinzufügen: Je nach Website-Builder (Shopify, Wix, Squarespace) fügen Sie den iframe-Code in einen HTML-Block ein

Das Einbetten funktioniert mit den meisten Website-Buildern, die benutzerdefinierte HTML-Blöcke unterstützen. Ihre eingebetteten Inhalte werden automatisch aktualisiert, wenn Sie Änderungen am ursprünglichen Gamma vornehmen.

source.body:
Hi Gamma Support team,

this is an urgent issue.

I am on a paid Plus plan and both of my published sites on Gamma are currently showing **Error 526 – Invalid SSL certificate**.

Here are the details:

– Original deck: https://hello-sabrina-backady-vnqaqap.gamma.site/

– New deck (copied content, brand-new project): https://sabrina-backady-r1pn2h8.gamma.site/

I have already:

– Unpublished all older decks,

– Cleared browser cache and cookies,

– Tested in multiple browsers and in Incognito/Private mode,

– Created a completely new project from scratch and published it once,

– Waited several hours between attempts.

Just to add more detail:

Two days ago I tested the original deck repeatedly throughout the day and it kept alternating between working for a few minutes and then showing the same Error 526 again and again.

Yesterday I created and published a completely new deck, and this one behaves exactly the same way - it may briefly load once, but then fails again.

So this is clearly not a browser- or caching-issue but an ongoing SSL problem on your servers.

The error persists in all cases, which clearly indicates a cluster-wide SSL issue on your side.

This situation is too unstable for professional use - I need consistent performance and reliable SSL handling, as I am using Gamma for my professional portfolio and need to share the link for applications today.

Please reissue or refresh the SSL certificate chain as soon as possible and confirm when it’s fixed.

Thank you very much for your quick help.

Best regards,

Sabrina Backady

To find your receipt for the $96.00 charge from 10/11/25, you can access our billing dashboard where all invoices and receipts are stored.

Here's how to locate your receipt:

  1. Go to Settings & Members - From the Gamma homepage, select Settings & members from the left-hand menu
  2. Open Manage Subscription - Click Billing > Manage subscription, which will open a new tab powered by Stripe, our billing platform
  3. View and download invoices - In the Stripe dashboard, scroll to find your invoice history. You can click into any invoice to view full details and download a PDF copy

The person listed on the account (Donnie Turner) will need to be an admin of the workspace to access these billing settings. Invoices are automatically emailed and can also be downloaded manually from this billing dashboard.

content_sources.title: Error codes
Does Gamma have an API?

conversation_parts.body:
The error message you received indicates that the value provided for image_url in your API call was not a valid base64-encoded data URL with an image MIME type. Gamma expects image uploads via the API to use a format like data:image/png;base64,... where the image data is properly base64-encoded. If the value is not correctly formatted or the base64 data is invalid, you'll see this input validation error. Double-check that your image_url parameter contains a valid base64-encoded image string and follows the required format to resolve this issue .

To publish all changes:

  1. Click the Publish button at the top of your site

To publish a single page:

  1. Open the Pages panel

conversation_parts.body:
To set a page as your homepage, you need to leave the URL path field blank when editing the page settings.

Here's how to do it:

  1. Open the Pages Panel - Click the Toggle Pages Panel in the top-left corner of your site editor
  2. Edit Page Settings - Hover over the page you want to make your homepage and click the three-dot menu (…)
  3. Set URL Path - Select the option to set the URL path and leave this field completely blank to make it your homepage
  4. Publish Changes - Click Publish to apply the changes

The "That path already exists" error typically occurs when there's conflicting path information. By leaving the URL path blank, you're telling our system this should be the root homepage. If you continue experiencing this specific error after following these steps, it may require backend examination to resolve the path conflict.

1. Open your published gamma site

2. Click the three-dot menu (…) in the top-right corner

3. Select Site settings

4. Add Google Tag Manager to connect analytics tools like Google Analytics

This will allow you to track traffic and performance through Google Analytics instead of built-in site analytics.

  1. Ve a la pantalla principal de Gamma y selecciona "Settings & members" desde el menú desplegable en la parte superior izquierda.

––– Translated by Lokalise Messages
​

This conversation language is Russian. Create a note starting with ! to respond in a customer's language or try !help

Если вы столкнулись с ошибкой недействительного SSL-сертификата на вашем сайте Gamma, это обычно связано с тем, что сертификат еще не был выпущен. После подключения или изменения домена может пройти несколько часов, прежде чем SSL-сертификат активируется. В это время возможны предупреждения о безопасности — попробуйте обновить страницу через несколько часов.

Если вы используете Cloudflare, убедитесь, что в настройках SSL/TLS выбран режим Full (Strict), а уровень безопасности установлен на Medium во время верификации домена. После успешной активации можно вернуть прежние настройки.

Если проблема с SSL-сертификатом сохраняется более 24 часов после настройки домена, это может требовать дополнительной проверки со стороны специалистов .

To publish all site changes:

  1. Click the Publish button in the top-right corner
  2. This applies updates across all pages, theme, and navigation

To publish a single page:

  1. Click the Publish dropdown in the top-right corner
  2. Select Publish current page

You can also use Preview to check how your site looks before publishing.

If you're seeing an error message about "Publishing is not enabled for this page" or similar publishing errors, this requires examination by a human agent who can investigate the specific issue with your site.

For PowerPoint:

For Google Slides:

Export as PowerPoint first, then upload the PPTX file to Google Slides

If export fails, try:

  • Check your internet connection
  • Split very long presentations into smaller sections
  • Compress large images that might be causing issues

The exported content will match how it appears in Present Mode, not Edit Mode

To remove your custom domain from your website in Gamma, just follow these steps:

  1. Open your Gamma site editor.
  2. Click on Site Settings (usually found in the top-right corner by clicking on the three dots).
  3. Go to the Custom Domain section.
  4. Click the trash icon next to your custom domain to remove it from Gamma.
  5. Save your changes.
  6. Then, go to your domain provider's website and access the DNS settings. Clear the A and CNAME records so your domain no longer points to Gamma.

Once you've done all of that, please go ahead and add your domain to Gamma again, and add the DNS records pointing to Gamma manually on your domain provider's end. Do not touch the DNS setting or interrupt the verification process during the next 24-48 hours once it's added.

Try publishing options:

  • Use "Publish current page" for single page updates
  • Or publish all site changes with the main Publish button

If you continue experiencing publishing blocks, please request to speak with a human agent who can examine your specific situation.

Para garantir que seus cartões tenham um tamanho fixo e não ultrapassem as dimensões desejadas, siga estes passos:

  1. Abra seu gamma.
  2. Clique no menu de três pontos (… ) no canto superior direito.
  3. Selecione Configuração da Página (Page Setup).
  4. No menu de configuração, localize a opção Tamanho do Cartão (Card Size).
  5. Escolha uma opção de altura fixa para manter a consistência dos cartões.

Ao selecionar uma altura fixa, o conteúdo dos cartões será ajustado para caber dentro das dimensões especificadas, evitando que ultrapassem o tamanho definido. Isso é especialmente útil para exportações, como slides de PowerPoint ou postagens em redes sociais.

Se o cartão ainda ficar muito alto devido ao excesso de conteúdo, considere dividir o conteúdo em mais de um cartão para melhor legibilidade.

What is Remix and how do I use it?

conversation_parts.body:
To create a duplicate of a presentation so you can work on it without changing the original, you have a couple of options:

  • Remix Feature:
    Use the Remix function to make a copy of your presentation. Click the three-dot menu (…) on your presentation (either from the dashboard or in the editor) and select the Remix option. This will create a new version that you can edit independently, leaving the original unchanged. You can also access Remix from the Templates section or the +New Gamma option on your dashboard. When you remix, you can rename the new copy and make any changes you need , .
  • Copy and Paste Cards:
    Alternatively, you can open your existing presentation, select all cards (Cmd + A on Mac or Ctrl + A on Windows), copy them, create a new presentation, and paste the cards into it. This also gives you a separate copy to edit as you wish .

Both methods ensure your original presentation remains untouched.

If you don't see the Remix option to duplicate a presentation, it could be due to where you're looking for it. The Remix feature is available by clicking the three-dot menu (…) on your presentation from the dashboard or within the editor. If you're working with workspace templates, you can also access Remix from the Templates section or the +New Gamma option on your dashboard. Note that Remix is available for any non-site gamma and workspace templates, but not for presentations that have been converted into sites. If you still can't find the option, double-check that you're not viewing a site or a restricted template, as Remix is not available in those cases. Anyone in your workspace should be able to use Remix, and it does not edit the original presentation—it creates a new copy for you to modify as needed.

A diferença de R$ 35,00 (totalizando R$ 395,00 em vez de R$ 360,00) provavelmente está relacionada ao sistema de cobrança por membro da Gamma.

Nossa cobrança funciona baseada no número de usuários ativos no seu workspace. Se você tem mais de um usuário no workspace, será cobrado por cada membro adicional.

  3. Verifique quantos usuários estão listados

Entiendo tu preocupación sobre los cobros después de cancelar. Hay algunas razones por las que esto puede ocurrir:

Posibles causas:

• Período de facturación activo: Tu suscripción permanece activa hasta que termine el período actual de facturación, incluso después de cancelar

The charge of $96 instead of $8 may be due to per-member billing—if your workspace included multiple members, you would be billed for each one, which can increase the total charge significantly. To review your charges and manage your subscription, go to Settings & members in the left panel, then open the Billing tab and select Manage subscription. Here, you can view your invoices, update payment methods, and cancel your subscription.

Refunds are only available within the first 7 days of subscribing, and only after contacting support. Since refund processing and removal of credit card details require human assistance, your request will need to be handled by a human agent.

To cancel your subscription, use the Cancel subscription option in the Billing tab. After cancellation, your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing cycle, and no further charges will occur unless you resubscribe. Removing your credit card details also requires human support intervention.

For your refund and card removal requests, please ask to speak with a human agent so they can assist you directly.

You can integrate your Gamma landing page with your CRM's website by embedding it using an iframe code.

Here's how to do it:

Generate the embed code:

  1. Open your Gamma landing page
  2. Click the Share button in the top-right corner
  3. Select Embed from the dropdown

Enable public access:

  1. Toggle Allow public access so your landing page is viewable when embedded
  2. Copy the generated iframe code

Add to your CRM website:

Most site builders that support custom HTML blocks will work with this method. Simply paste the iframe code into an HTML block on your CRM's website.

Make sure your iframe dimensions are responsive or manually adjust width and height as needed for optimal display.

Password reset not working?

Once logged in successfully, you can add a password for future logins by going to your profile icon > Account Settings > Sign in & security > Add Password.

Try the Google login method first, as this is the most common cause of this error.

conversation_parts.body:
To format a photo to fit properly in Gamma, you have several options depending on your image type:

For standard images:

  • Click and drag the corners to resize proportionally
  • Use the Crop tool: click the image, select Crop from the toolbar, adjust the selection, and click Apply

For accent images (part of card layouts):

  • Switch between Fit Mode (keeps entire image visible) and Fill Mode (expands to cover area, cropping edges) in the image menu
  • Adjust the focus point by clicking "Change focus point" and dragging the circle to reposition what's visible
  • Manually adjust width by clicking and dragging the edge

For images in smart layouts:

  • Select the image and use the layout menu to adjust size and position
  • Use the focus point tool to reposition the image within the layout

You can also resize any image by clicking and dragging its borders after insertion.

! Thanks for the clarification. Exported PDFs reflect your deck’s Present Mode view, and some visual differences (like background images) may occur during export.

To check this:

  1. Switch to Present Mode and see if the background appears correctly there.
  2. Try exporting a few pages as a test PDF.
  3. If the issue persists, try exporting as PPTX instead—this format often preserves background images better.
  4. Large or numerous images may cause exports to fail or render incorrectly. Try compressing your background image or replacing it with a screenshot to reduce the file size.

conversation_parts.body:
Gamma doesn't have a built-in way to merge entire workspaces, but you can manually transfer your content from the free workspace to your Plus workspace.

To transfer your gammas:

1. Copy all cards from each gamma in your free workspace by pressing Cmd + A (Mac) or Ctrl + A (Windows) twice in the filmstrip to select all cards

2. Copy the selected cards with Cmd + C (Mac) or Ctrl + C (Windows)

3. Open your Plus workspace and create a new gamma or open an existing one

4. Paste the cards using Cmd + V (Mac) or Ctrl + V (Windows)

The pasted cards will retain their content and formatting but inherit the theme of the new gamma. You can copy cards between different workspaces, so this process will work to move content from your free account to your Plus account.

Repeat this process for each gamma you want to transfer from your free workspace to your Plus workspace.

Para cancelar sua assinatura, siga estes passos:

  1. Acesse as configurações: Selecione "Settings & members" no painel esquerdo
  2. Vá para a aba Billing: Clique na aba "Billing" e localize a seção "Manage subscription"
  3. Cancele a assinatura: Selecione "Cancel subscription" e confirme o cancelamento no Stripe

Importante: Sua assinatura permanecerá ativa até o final do período de cobrança atual. Para evitar renovação automática, cancele pelo menos 30 dias antes da data de renovação.

Sobre reembolsos: Você não receberá automaticamente um reembolso ao cancelar. Reembolsos estão disponíveis apenas nos primeiros 7 dias após a assinatura e somente entrando em contato com nosso suporte.

How do I find or update my invoice for my Gamma purchase?

conversation_parts.body:
You can update your VAT number directly in your subscription settings. Go to Settings & Members, then click Billing > Manage subscription to access the Stripe dashboard where you can add or update your Tax ID/VAT number.

Important: Changes to your invoice information will only appear on your next billing cycle. If you're on a monthly plan, the VAT number will show on next month's invoice. For yearly plans, it will appear when your subscription renews next year.

If you need your current invoice updated immediately with the VAT number, you'll need to request human support as they can cancel your current plan, issue a refund if applicable, update the information, and then you can upgrade again.

The Toggle Pages view is the key to managing multiple pages in your site.

source.subject: URGENTE — Erro SSL, redirecionamento indevido e limitação de domínios no Gamma
source.body:
Olá, equipe Gamma.

Preciso de ajuda imediata para resolver três problemas graves que estão comprometendo totalmente o funcionamento das minhas páginas e impactando diretamente as vendas e campanhas em andamento.

🚨 1. Erro SSL — Invalid Certificate (Error 526)

O domínio https://cursomakereal-o85tp03.gamma.site/ está apresentando o erro “Invalid SSL certificate (Error code 526)”, conforme a imagem em anexo.
O Cloudflare indica que o navegador e o proxy estão funcionando normalmente, mas o servidor da Gamma está retornando erro de certificado inválido.
➡️ Isso torna as páginas inacessíveis e está causando perdas diretas de tráfego e conversão.
Solicito que o SSL seja reemitido ou corrigido imediatamente, pois se trata de um problema interno da hospedagem Gamma.

⚠️ 2. Mensagem “You’re Leaving Gamma” em links internos

Mesmo ao usar links que direcionam para outras páginas dentro do próprio Gamma, aparece uma tela intermediária com o aviso em inglês “You’re leaving Gamma”, obrigando o visitante a clicar novamente em “Continue”.
Esse aviso confunde o público, diminui drasticamente as conversões e não faz sentido quando o link é interno.
Peço que essa tela seja desativada para links dentro do domínio .gamma.site ou que seja adicionada uma opção para removê-la manualmente.

🔒 3. Limitação de 10 domínios personalizados

Percebi que a plataforma passou a limitar o uso a apenas 10 domínios personalizados.
Mesmo após excluir domínios antigos que não estão mais em uso, não consigo adicionar novos.
Esse bloqueio está impedindo novas publicações e atualizações de campanhas.
Peço, por favor, que liberem espaço para novos domínios ou aumentem temporariamente o limite da minha conta.

💬 Pedido de contato direto

Esses três problemas estão afetando todo o meu ecossistema de páginas e vendas.
Preciso de atendimento ao vivo (chat, ligação ou videoconferência) o quanto antes, para que possamos resolver em tempo real.

A situação é crítica e peço prioridade máxima neste chamado.

Agradeço pela atenção e aguardo retorno urgente.

Atenciosamente,
Lucas Carvalho

email da conta: lucas.imvdigital@gmail.com

conversation_parts.body:
Cloudflare error 526 typically indicates SSL certificate issues with your custom domains. This is often related to SSL/TLS configuration problems in Cloudflare.

To resolve this issue:

1. Check your Cloudflare SSL/TLS settings:

- Go to SSL/TLS > Overview in your Cloudflare dashboard

- Set the SSL/TLS encryption mode to Full (Strict)

2. Adjust security settings during verification:

- Navigate to Security > Settings

- Set Security Level to Medium during the verification process

Important notes:

- SSL certificates can take a few hours to activate after domain verification

- Security warnings are normal immediately after domain setup and should resolve within a few hours

- If issues persist after 24 hours, this requires examination by our human support team

Since you're experiencing this across multiple sites and it may require certificate reissuance, I'd recommend requesting to speak with a human agent who can examine your specific SSL certificate status and take the necessary actions to resolve this issue.
